description: This file defines the LoginHistory class for managing user login and logout records in vtiger CRM, including methods for recording login/logout events, retrieving login history, and generating list queries.

classes.name: LoginHistory
classes.description: Class for managing user login history, including recording login/logout events and retrieving login history data.

methods.name: LoginHistory
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger and database instances.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewHeader
methods.description: Returns header labels for login history list view.

methods.name: getHistoryListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves login history entries for a specific user with pagination.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Creates SQL query for listing login history with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: firstTimeLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user is logging in for the first time within a specified delay.
